subject: A field of curved black and white bands with a gradual wave
prompt:
USER SUBJECT: A field of curved black and white bands with a gradual wave
Preserve the user's requested identities, counts, setting, and layout. Add no default motifs.
VISUAL MEDIUM: flat_painting_or_print
REPRESENTATION: nonfigurative
APPLY THESE AUTHORED VISUAL RULES:
- [measured-serial-progression] Select one band, curve, or cell unit and repeat it across the field; introduce a controlled progression in spacing, width, curvature, or direction, with at most a few intentional interruptions.
- [contrast-through-adjacency] Begin with a controlled set of adjacent values or colors; let contrast arise where units meet, and add hue only when it strengthens the sequence rather than becoming a global glow.
- [flat-plane-and-edge-control] Keep the image on one flat plane with clean, stable edges and subtle hand-made variation; do not use perspective convergence, cast shadows, or material texture to imply a physical corridor or object.
- [rhythm-contrast-flatness-coherence] Let repeated units, their contrast, and edge behavior form one consistent visual sequence on a flat plane; maintain enough clarity for the eye to follow the progression.
REQUIREMENT: Declare the abstract-field context before applying the direction.
REQUIREMENT: Preserve a measurable unit and coherent progression across the whole image.
REQUIREMENT: Generate perceptual movement through adjacency, not simulated light or depth.
REQUIREMENT: Keep edges clear and contrast controlled.

scope.description: An abstract-field direction built from repeated geometric units whose spacing, width, curvature, or value changes in a controlled sequence, producing perceptual movement on a flat surface without simulating literal three-dimensional depth.
limitations: Use only when the caller requests an abstract field; do not transform a person, object, or place into stripes without asking for that treatment.
Build a new rhythm and geometry; do not recreate a known Riley composition or named work.
Keep contrast and repetition readable without flicker claims, extreme strobing, or neon glow.

rules.instruction: Select one band, curve, or cell unit and repeat it across the field; introduce a controlled progression in spacing, width, curvature, or direction, with at most a few intentional interruptions.
rules.observable: The eye can follow a coherent sequence, and any local disruption sharpens rather than breaks the overall rhythm.
rules.reject_when: Units vary randomly, repetitions lose a readable progression, or ornament competes with the field's underlying structure.
rules.avoid: random stripe variation, decorative flourishes, and arbitrary focal objects

rules.applies_when: Adjacent units create a value or color interaction.
rules.instruction: Begin with a controlled set of adjacent values or colors; let contrast arise where units meet, and add hue only when it strengthens the sequence rather than becoming a global glow.
rules.observable: The field appears to pulse, bend, or shift through adjacency while each region remains a flat, distinct painted shape.
rules.reject_when: Gradient lighting, neon glow, or uniform color tint creates the effect instead of the relationships between units.
rules.avoid: neon glow, gradient overlays, and uniform color filters

rules.instruction: Keep the image on one flat plane with clean, stable edges and subtle hand-made variation; do not use perspective convergence, cast shadows, or material texture to imply a physical corridor or object.
rules.observable: The optical effect remains active without the field appearing to depict a tunnel, bulging object, or light source.
rules.reject_when: Shading creates literal volume, texture overwhelms the pattern, or edges become mechanically perfect and sterile.
rules.avoid: literal tunnels, cast shadows, simulated relief, and texture overlays

joint_checks.instruction: Let repeated units, their contrast, and edge behavior form one consistent visual sequence on a flat plane; maintain enough clarity for the eye to follow the progression.
joint_checks.observable: The field produces controlled perceptual movement, remains visibly flat, and has no single effect that conflicts with the sequence.
